title: Phase-sensitive 404
description: HTTP 404 classification is not restricted to the declared initial Preflight GET.
rationale: Permissive Preflight absence handling must never leak into Apply or Readback.
remediation: Classify 404 as CREATE_MISSING only for an explicitly allowed initial Preflight GET; all Apply and Readback 404 responses are GET_FAILED.

residualGate.description: Preflight and Apply response readback remain external.
